http://soundbounce.org/

Soundbounce is basically a user made version that is populated with some Soundrop refugees after Spotify discontinued app support earlier this year. Premium account required. There is a standalone app that can stream at 320kbps, and there is a chrome extension too that has been recently released.

If you're unfamiliar with the concept, it consists of user made "rooms" that anyone can join. Usually a room is dedicated to a genre but it can be whatever you want it to be. Users vote up songs they want to hear that fit the theme and the song with the most votes gets played next, the play queue is side by side with a chat so you can chat to the other users in the room. Great community, updated regularly, the lead coder is a great guy, and an amazing way of getting into new genres.

Just spreading the word :)

The Logical Language Group - This place has pretty much everything you need. It has audio too I think, so you'll be able to hear examples of pronunciation.
